injuries.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.
Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.
Flemings (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Bulls.
Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
Swain (back) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Atlanta.
Powell (shoulder) is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
